title: Cover
//: A cover is a thumbnail, not a writing surface. Override title and emoji on the command line rather than copying this file per notebook.
//margins: Symmetric 44 pt clears the pinned toolbar on either side and keeps the title centred on the page. margin_top is the cap top of the title.

blocks.//: One emoji, from the system emoji font. Its colour layers are mapped to greys and given a dark contour, so it keeps its internal detail. Single code points only; ring shapes (compass, gear, target) collapse into the same donut at thumbnail size.
